entries.title: Psalms 33:1
segments: Rejoice in Jehovah, O ye righteous: Praise is comely for the upright.

entries.title: Psalms 33:2
segments: Give thanks unto Jehovah with the harp: Sing praises unto him with the psaltery of ten strings.

entries.title: Psalms 33:3
segments: Sing unto him a new song; Play skilfully with a loud noise.

entries.title: Psalms 33:4
segments: For the word of Jehovah is right; And all his work is [done] in faithfulness.

entries.title: Psalms 33:5
segments: He loveth righteousness and justice: The earth is full of the lovingkindness of Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 33:6
segments: By the word of Jehovah were the heavens made, And all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 33:7
segments: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap: He layeth up the deeps in store-houses.

entries.title: Psalms 33:8
segments: Let all the earth fear Jehovah: Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

entries.title: Psalms 33:9
segments: For he spake, and it was done; He commanded, and it stood fast.

entries.title: Psalms 33:10
segments: Jehovah bringeth the counsel of the nations to nought; He maketh the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

entries.title: Psalms 33:11
segments: The counsel of Jehovah standeth fast for ever, The thoughts of his heart to all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 33:12
segments: Blessed is the nation whose God is Jehovah, The people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 33:13
segments: Jehovah looketh from heaven; He beholdeth all the sons of men;

entries.title: Psalms 33:14
segments: From the place of his habitation he looketh forth Upon all the inhabitants of the earth,

entries.title: Psalms 33:15
segments: He that fashioneth the hearts of them all, That considereth all their works.

entries.title: Psalms 33:16
segments: There is no king saved by the multitude of a host: A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

entries.title: Psalms 33:17
segments: A horse is a vain thing for safety; Neither doth he deliver any by his great power.

entries.title: Psalms 33:18
segments: Behold, the eye of Jehovah is upon them that fear him, Upon them that hope in his lovingkindness;

entries.title: Psalms 33:19
segments: To deliver their soul from death, And to keep them alive in famine.

entries.title: Psalms 33:20
segments: Our soul hath waited for Jehovah: He is our help and our shield.

entries.title: Psalms 33:21
segments: For our heart shall rejoice in him, Because we have trusted in his holy name.

entries.title: Psalms 33:22
segments: Let thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, be upon us, According as we have hoped in thee.
